title: Quantitative Higher-Order Hankel-SOS Magic Lower Bounds, Infinite-Family Odd-Dimension Blind-Spot Separation, and Reverse-Monotonicity of Even-Moment Mana
abstract: Advancing Sharma, Chakrabarty, Mukherjee, Mallick, and Maity (arXiv:2611.34668v1), we prove four original structural theorems closing the gap between qualitative higher-order Hankel Wigner-negativity detection and quantitative magic lower bounds: (1) a Universal Level-m Hankel-SOS Quantitative Negativity Theorem converting any negative Hankel witness v with M_v > 0 into N(rho) >= (-v^T H_m v)/M_v, recovering Sharma Theorem 4 identically as its unique optimal m=1 dual (lambda* = (P+b)/(1+P)), closing the blind zone of ququint rho_2(p) down to p=0.45 via exact-Q Schur and root-interpolating witnesses, and beating B_3 by 2.11x at p=0.59 and 1.26x at p=0.60; (2) an Unconditional Signed-Decomposition Cubic Saturation Inequality; (3) an Infinite-Family Odd-Dimension (H_1, B_4)-Blind-Spot Separation Theorem for every odd D >= 3; and (4) a Higher-Even-Moment Multiplicative Mana Family Lambda_{2k} with a sharp Reverse-Monotonicity Theorem proving Lambda_4 >= Lambda_6 >= Lambda_8 >= ... (uniqueness of k=2). Core algebraic inequalities are formally verified across 22 Lean 4.36.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 grind, 0 custom axioms), paired with a zero-float exact-Q verifier, 16 canonical SHA-256 certificates, and 65 tests.
